title: Greta Gerwig channels Bowie in psychedelic The Magician's Nephew trailer
gist: Netflix released the trailer for Greta Gerwig's Narnia: The Magician's Nephew, set for a Feb 12, 2027 theatrical release and an April 2, 2027 Netflix stream. It is Netflix's first wide theatrical release and the first of a two-picture Narnia deal.

insights.claim: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew opens in theaters February 12, 2027 and streams on Netflix April 2, 2027, making it the first Netflix film to get a wide theatrical release.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: A roughly seven-week theatrical window marks a shift in Netflix's release model; watch box office as a test of the hybrid approach.
insights.locator: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew will open in theaters

insights.claim: Gerwig has a two-picture deal for the Netflix Narnia series, so The Lion, the Witch, and the Wardrobe may come next.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Signals Netflix is building a multi-film Narnia franchise around a proven director.

insights.claim: Gerwig chose Narnia for Netflix after Barbie earned nearly $1.5 billion at the box office in 2023.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Netflix is landing top-tier talent with franchise IP, raising its leverage against studios.

insights.claim: Earlier Narnia film adaptations showed diminishing returns and the film rights had expired by 2011, before the property returned via Netflix.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Dormant IP with proven fan base is being revived by streamers as a franchise bet.

insights.claim: Gerwig moves the story from 1900 to postwar 1950s London and cast includes Daniel Craig, Carey Mulligan, Emma Mackey and Meryl Streep voicing Aslan; she has cited 1960s David Bowie as inspiration and said it is not a musical.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: A star-heavy cast and a distinct creative tone are marketing levers for a high-budget release.
insights.locator: The original book was set in 1900
